notes: New horror mod: Playmate (Mods > Converted - off until you turn it on). Stay awake two nights, and on the third it wants to play hide and seek. Hide: it counts, then it looks for you for a minute - light, footsteps and building give you away, and it opens doors. Seek: eyes shut while it hides, then find it three times before time runs out.
Let it see you, or lose, and it runs at you... Sleeping resets the nights. Works in singleplayer and on servers with the HybridHorrorKit plugin; only players who turn it on play.
